children: Saudi Arabia’s residential rental solutions platform Rize has secured SAR 187.5 million ($50 million) in debt financing from Jadwa Investment, an investment bank and asset manager.
The asset-backed Murabaha facility will go directly to funding the platform’s portfolio of residential rental contracts.
The company operates a “Rent Now, Pay Later” model that enables tenants to pay their annual rents in 12 monthly instalments while landlords receive upfront payments.
Rize caters to more than 200,000 tenants, 3,000 landlords and 1,200 real estate brokers.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Saudi proptech Rize secures $50mln debt financing from Jadwa Investment
